item.title: Millionways Launches Thorsten-4 Large Psychology Model
item.description:
Millionways has launched Thorsten-4, a Large Psychology Model that scores each person in a conversation across 50 behavioral and psychological traits. Its training data comes from over 35 million words hand-tagged by trained psychologists from repeated interviews with more than 7,000 people over four years, rather than scraped web text. The model aims to move from reading text to reading people, predicting hesitation, withholding and disengagement.

原文标题：Thorsten-4 发布 用 3500 万词训练心理大模型

Why it matters：首个以人工标注真实访谈数据训练的心理学专用大模型，开辟垂直基座新方向。

item.title: AWS Publishes A2A Reference Architecture for Cross-Org Multi-Agent Systems
item.description:
AWS published a reference architecture built on the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol that lets multi-agent systems spanning organizational boundaries discover each other, communicate, and exchange tasks via Agent Card registration, without shared frameworks or exposed internals. The design pairs a LangChain-based orchestrator with Strands Agents-built agents, targeting ISVs and enterprises exposing agents across boundaries.

item.title: Amazon Introduces Agent DLC Framework for Production Agents
item.description:
Amazon introduces the Agent Development Lifecycle (Agent DLC), arguing that moving agents from prototype to production requires one lifecycle, two loops, and a single explicit standard for judging every change, since traditional unit tests and CI/CD are necessary but insufficient for agents. A measured case shows how an aggregate metric can mask a coverage problem, motivating repeatable, affordable evaluation, with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore providing observability, runtime, tool integration, and memory management.

原文标题：亚马逊提出 Agent DLC 框架 推动智能体生产化

Why it matters：为智能体工程化落地提供了可复用的评估与生命周期方法论，并给出聚合指标掩盖覆盖缺陷的实证案例。

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns as Market Value Plunges $550 Billion
item.description:
Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO amid a scandal, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim chief, triggering a broad selloff across global AI stocks. Nvidia fell 8.2% intraday, dropping below a $4 trillion market cap for the first time since July 2025, with over $550 billion wiped out since the board opened its investigation; CoreWeave and Nebius also slumped, while AMD and Broadcom rose 3.7% and 5.6%. The shakeup exposes risks in Nvidia's circular chip-and-infrastructure financing model and forces a repricing of the entire AI supply chain.

item.title: Show HN Launches Arcade of One-Shot Fable 5.2 HTML Games
item.description:

Each game inlines markup, CSS, JavaScript, shaders and synthesized audio into one .html file, running offline via WebGL and the Web Audio API with no server or build step. The site also exposes the original prompts and accepts community submissions, offering an interactive window into long-horizon agent coding.

item.title: Running Up to 16B Parameter LLMs on a 1.9GB RAM TV Box
item.description:
The smolmaxxing project demonstrates running language models from 260K to 16B parameters on a Xiaomi TV Box S (Amlogic S7D, ~1GB usable RAM, no root) using custom kernels, smarter memory use and weight streaming. Qwen3.5-0.8B reaches 16.8 tok/s (2.2x stock), while an 8B MoE model hits 7.2 tok/s via on-demand expert paging from flash. All claims are measured back-to-back on real hardware, offering a reproducible engineering playbook for edge-side local inference.

原文标题：在 1.9 GB 内存电视盒子上跑通 16B 参数模型

Why it matters：在极低内存消费级硬件上跑通 16B 级模型并给出可复现实测数据，对边缘推理与端侧部署有直接参考价值。

item.title: Enabling 32 GB Resizable BAR for Four GPUs on Linux
item.description:
The author runs four AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700s and two RTX 3090s behind a Broadcom PEX88096 PCIe switch, with eight lanes per card. Because ROCm enables peer-to-peer only when each card's full 32 GB BAR is mapped, they wrote a kernel module, gpu-rebar-layout, to resize BARs on Linux, noting that an upstream patch fixes sizing but this board still needs the module's resize and rescan logic.

原文标题：Linux 下为四张 32 GB 显卡配置可调整 BAR

Why it matters：面向多卡本地推理与训练玩家，给出了 PCIe 交换芯片下 Resizable BAR 与 ROCm P2P 的实操路径与内核模块。

item.title: Google Unveils Privacy Safeguards for Android XR Smart Glasses
item.description:

The measures are not technically novel, but they directly address consumer concerns in a market where rivals' privacy missteps have set a low bar.

Why it matters：谷歌首次系统披露 Android XR 眼镜的隐私设计细节，是智能眼镜能否被大众接受的关键变量。

item.title: LibreAGI Launches Private BitTorrent Tracker to Preserve Open Model Weights
